description: Sidebar button that navigates to the metric Builder view and highlights when the builder route is active.
Sidebar button that navigates to the Explorer view and highlights when the explorer route is active.

Sidebar button that navigates to the match Library view and highlights whenever a match-related route (library, match, round, replay, compare) is active — the player profile route highlights Profiles instead.
Right-hand pane beside the sidebar where the current routed view (Library, Match, Settings, etc.) renders.
Sidebar button that navigates to the player directory and highlights while the profiles list or a player profile route is open.
Sidebar button that navigates to the Reports view and highlights when the reports route is active.
Sidebar button that navigates to the Settings view and highlights when the settings route is active.
Left-hand navigation rail listing the app's six top-level views, always visible along the left edge of the window.
Logo icon plus the "spectra" app name pinned at the top of the sidebar.
Sidebar button that navigates to the SQL console view and highlights when the sql route is active.
Full-window dimmed backdrop behind the command palette; clicking it outside the panel closes the palette.
Centered modal dialog holding the search box, result sections, and shortcut footer; opened with Ctrl/⌘K.
Text input at the top of the palette where typing fuzzy-searches nav actions, matches, players, saved filters, metrics, and saved queries.
Bolded subsequence of characters within a result label showing which letters matched the typed query.
Empty-state text `No results for "…".` shown when a typed query returns nothing.
Clickable and arrow-key-selectable result row that runs its action or navigation when clicked or pressed with Enter.
Muted secondary text on a result row, such as match id and date, player match count, or filter scope.
"Searching…" status text shown below the section headers while async result sources are still resolving.
Small heading above each result group such as "Actions", "Matches", "Players", "Saved filters", "Metrics", or "Saved queries".
Footer strip of keyboard hints reading "↑↓ move", "Enter run", "Esc close", and "Ctrl/⌘K toggle".
Palette action row labeled "Toggle theme (now dark/light)" that flips the app theme when run.
"Choose folder…" button on the extraction prompt opening the native folder picker for a non-Steam or custom CS2 install.
Monospace path of the detected CS2 install shown on the extraction prompt.
Fine print on the extraction prompt: images are read from the user's game files, stay in Spectra's data folder, and nothing Valve ships with the app.
"Extract radar images" primary button on the extraction prompt that runs the local extraction and shows "Extracting…" while busy.
Dimmed full-window backdrop behind the extraction prompt; clicking it outside the panel closes the prompt (except while extracting).
Modal dialog shown once when a local CS2 install is found, offering to extract official radar images locally.
Status line on the extraction prompt reporting how many map packs were extracted and any per-map failures.
"Not now" button on the extraction prompt that declines permanently (the prompt never returns).
"Check for Updates…" button in the Settings About panel that triggers an immediate update check (moved out of the removed Help menu).
Native OS file-open dialog filtered to "CS2 demos" (*.dem;*.dem.zst) for selecting demos to import, opened from the Library import flow.
Small red button at the end of an active job row that cancels that import.
Percentage text such as "42%" shown beside the progress bar inside a status chip while progress is between 0 and 100.
Mini inline bar inside a parsing or running status chip showing import progress; renders indeterminate at 0%.
Small red button in a match row's Actions column that deletes the match's extracted data.

Two in-app confirmation modals (ConfirmDialog.svelte over Dialog.svelte) after clicking Delete: "Delete extracted data?" then "Also delete the demo file?" — Cancel, Escape and a backdrop click all mean no.
Small red button on an import-dir row that deletes the demo file itself after an in-app confirmation modal; the backend refuses anything that is not a demo file under a configured import dir.

short human name: Demos from your import dirs panel
description: Panel below the matches table listing .dem/.dem.zst files under the configured import dirs that are not in the library yet (recognised imports are omitted), newest first, each with Import and Delete from disk.
Muted "or drop .dem / .dem.zst files" hint beside the Import button in the Library header.
"No matches yet" message with import instructions and an Import button, shown when there are no matches and no jobs.
Import… button inside the empty library state that opens the same file picker as the header button.
Opens the native file picker to import CS2 demos; sits in the Library header (a second copy appears in the empty state).
Red alert under the Library header shown when the import file picker or import call fails.
Monospace basename of the demo file on each job row, with the full path as tooltip.
One line per active import inside the "Imports in progress" panel.
One failed/cancelled job line: status chip, monospace filename and error message.
Horizontal (indeterminate when unknown) progress bar on each active import job row.
Percentage text beside the progress bar on each active import job row.
Chip on each active job row showing pipeline stage: queued, decompressing, parsing, storing, analyzing or done.
Panel above the matches table listing queued/running imports with filename, stage chip, progress bar, percent and Cancel.
Drop target covering the entire Library view — dropping .dem/.dem.zst files anywhere imports them.
Red alert under the Library header shown when loading matches or jobs fails.
CT–T score cell in the Score column with the CT number styled blue and the T number orange.
Search box in the Library header that filters the match list by map, path or team as you type.
Small colored chip showing a match or job lifecycle state (ready, queued, parsing, failed, running, done, cancelled) in the library table, the imports-in-progress panel, and the match header.
Clickable (and Enter-key focusable) row in the matches table that navigates to that match.

Main library table of imported matches with Map, Matchup, Score, Rounds, Duration, Size, Extracted, Status and Actions columns; headers sort the list when clicked (Matchup and Actions are not sortable) and rows open the match view.
Clickable column header in the matches table that sorts the list server-side and shows ↑/↓ when active; the first click applies the column's natural default (newest/largest first, A→Z for names).
Message under the matches table when it is empty — either "No matches match query" after a search or "No matches yet — imports will appear here."
Panel above the drop zone listing recent failed/cancelled imports (last 7 days, max 10) with status, filename and error.
Small button in a match row's Actions column that re-parses the original demo.
Embedded Explorer diagnostics (Provenance, Entity summary, Network message census) rendered when the Details tab is active, with the Key facts list above them.
Definition list at the top of the Details tab: Server, Tickrate, Frames, Size, Extracted, Parser, Voice, Warnings, First blood and Source path.
Embedded combat-stats view rendered when the Combat tab is active.

Overview panel table of the team that finished CT, headed by that team's display name (demo clan name, else team_<player>, else "CT") with Player, K/D/A and ADR columns; clicking a row opens that player's events in the Replay landmark feed; the player name itself is a profile link.
Highlight styling on the round cell matching the round currently open in Round Detail.
"derived" chip next to a player name in the roster tables when they were absent from the final snapshot and stats came from events.
Embedded Economy analysis view rendered in the match body when the Economy tab is active.
🔒 chip in the subtitle shown when encrypted chat exists but the .dem.info key was not found.
Expandable panel under the match header listing parser warnings, with a dismiss ✕ and loading/empty states.
Key-facts row naming the match's first kill (killer, victim and round); both names link to their profiles and take the side each player had in that round.
Embedded heatmap view rendered when the Heatmaps tab is active.
"Loading…" placeholder shown while the match view is still fetching its data.
Error alert "Match not found." when the match id has no matching record.
Large team name – score – team name title at the top of the match view (team names, never the sides)
Nav of tabs (Overview, Scoreboard, Rounds, Economy, Utility, Combat, Heatmaps, Reports, Details) — Timeline/Chat/Context retired into the Replay landmark feed; tabs switch in-page panels.
Muted meta line under the scoreline: map, half score (numbered the way the two teams are displayed), duration, patch, status chip and the encrypted-chat key badge.
Small table under the second roster for players outside both sides, showing name, K/D/A and ADR.

One of five clickable cards on the Overview tab (Top fragger, Best ADR, Most util, Entry opens, Most MVPs) that opens the Replay landmark feed filtered to that player; the sub-line player name is itself a profile link while the rest of the card keeps that Replay drill.
Primary action directly under the scoreline (play codicon, "Watch replay") opening the replay view for the whole match from tick 0.
Small chip showing a player's ADR value in the Overview roster tables.

Winner-tinted (CT blue / T yellow) round-number button that opens that round's detail view and carries an arrow pointing toward the team that won it (▲ above, ▼ below); warmup/knife or no-winner rounds are muted.

Horizontal row of numbered round cells showing round-by-round winners with the two teams labelled above and below, arrows pointing at each round's winning team, and a split after real round 12 (MR12 halftime); centered in the match header and also displayed above round detail views.

Overview panel table of the team that finished T, headed by that team's display name (demo clan name, else team_<player>, else "T") with the same Player, K/D/A and ADR columns; the player name itself is a profile link.
Embedded utility-analysis view rendered when the Utility tab is active.
🔊 chip in the subtitle showing voice chunk count and player count, or a "no voice" variant when the demo has no voice track.
One bulleted parser warning string in the extraction warnings panel.
Small ✕ button in the warnings panel header that closes it.
"None — the parser ran clean." in the match header's warnings panel.
"Loading…" placeholder inside the warnings panel before warnings are fetched.
Header button labeled "N warnings" (warn-styled when non-zero) or "Warnings" that opens the extraction warnings panel.
"bot" badge next to a bot's name in the scoreboard Name column.
Mini table (Weapon, Damage) beside the kills table in the expanded scoreboard row.
Hover definition on the KAST% header explaining the formula and trade-window rule source.
Red alert at the top of the Scoreboard tab when per-player KAST stats fail to load.
Mini table (Weapon, Kills) in the expanded scoreboard row, or "None recorded" when empty.
ⓘ next to a pinned metric header showing the metric's documentation on hover.
"(N)" count in a pinned metric header showing total sample size across players.
Scoreboard cell for a pinned metric, formatted per the metric; tooltip shows sample size or "no data for this player".
Extra scoreboard header for a metric pinned in Builder: sortable title, ⓘ tooltip, sample-size count and ✕ unpin.
Red alert at the top of the Scoreboard tab when pinned custom metric columns fail to load.
Name-cell button in the scoreboard that opens that player's profile page (bots render as plain text).
Clicking a scoreboard row (away from buttons) opens the Replay landmark feed filtered to that player; rows are Enter-key focusable.
Clickable column header that sorts the scoreboard (shows ↑/↓ when active); KAST% and pinned metric columns sort in the browser.
One numeric scoreboard cell (kills, ADR, HS%, K/D, etc.) formatted per column.

Full per-player stats table on the Scoreboard tab with Name, Team, K, D, A, ADR, KAST%, HS%, K/D, KDA, DMG, Rnds, 5K, 4K, 3K, Entry, Trade, Opening K/D, Streak, Util, MVPs and Score columns, plus any pinned metric columns.
CT/T side chip used in the round winner cells, equip columns, and the player profile's sides and history tables (the scoreboard's Team column shows the team's display name instead).
✕ on a pinned metric header that removes the column from the scoreboard and updates localStorage.
▸/▾ toggle at the start of each scoreboard row that expands that player's weapon breakdown.
Full-width row under an expanded scoreboard player showing Kills by weapon and Damage by weapon mini-tables.
Floating primary button (appears with 2–4 rounds selected) that opens the round-comparison view.
Text under the Rounds table: "N of 4 rounds selected — warmup rounds cannot be compared."
Colored CT/T chips showing each side's equipment value in the Rounds table.
Buy/round classification chip (pistol, eco, force, etc.) in the Rounds table, round detail header, and comparison columns whose tooltip shows the rule, rule version and confidence.
Red alert on the Rounds tab when round classification data fails to load.
Checkbox in the Cmp column selecting a non-warmup round for comparison (max 4; later ones disable).

Per-round table on the Rounds tab with Cmp checkbox, № (negative for knife/warmup rounds, first-half pistol = 1), Winner, Class, Reason (human-readable: Elimination, Bomb exploded, Bomb defused, …), Duration, Site, MVP, Equip CT, Equip T, First blood and Kills columns; rows open the round detail; the MVP and first-blood names link to their profiles and take the side each player had in that round.
"wu" chip next to a warmup round's negative number in the Rounds table.
"knife" chip next to a pre-match knife round's negative number in the Rounds table (also shown beside the round title in Round detail).
Header button that opens the standalone Explorer diagnostics view for this match.
"← Back" button returning to the origin recorded in ?back= (the tab or view that opened this round), falling back to the match overview; also in the Compare rounds no-selection hint.
"No economy samples." placeholder row in the round's economy table.
Right-side panel table with per-side CT/T chip, Equip value and sampled average Money for the round.
"Round N →" button in the bottom round navigation, shown when a later round exists (the label names the actual next round, which is negative for pre-match rounds).
"← Round N" button in the bottom round navigation, shown when an earlier round exists (rounds count up from the first-half pistol, with negative knife/warmup rounds before it).
One chat line in the round chat panel: muted tick, bold speaker name and message text.
Right-side panel listing this round's chat messages, or "No chat this round." when none.
Classification label chip (e.g. eco, force) beside the round title with rule, version and confidence tooltip.
Error alert shown when the requested round does not exist for the match.
"Round N" heading at the top of the round detail view.

Muted meta paragraph under the title: round reason, duration, bomb site, equip values, kill count, MVP (with reason) and round start/end times in seconds; the MVP and first-kill names link to their profiles with that round's side color.
CT/T side chip beside the round title (and in round tables and comparison columns) showing the winning side ("—" if none).
"warmup" badge beside the round title on warmup rounds.
Primary "▶ Watch round" button in the round detail header opening the replay at the round's start tick.
Header card with career ADR ± σ (standard deviation as consistency measure).
Header card showing kills ÷ deaths across all matches.
Header card showing detected 1vN clutches and the share won.

Panel with per-map splits: matches, wins and ADR.

Panel listing recent matches (date, map, result, score, side, K/D/A, ADR, KAST%).
Header card with total matches in the library and wins for the player.
Header card showing detected opening-duel win rate.
Displays the profiled player's in-game name in the profile header.
Returns to the library view; top-left of the Player Profile header.
Shows the placeholder heading "Player" when no profile is loaded yet.
"Find players…" search input in the profile header; type-ahead searches the library.
Clickable result showing name, match count and average ADR; navigates to that player's profile.
Listbox of matching players that appears under the search box while typing.
Alert shown in the view when the profile fails to load or is not found.
"Loading…" text shown while the profile request is in flight.
Panel with per-side (CT/T) splits: matches, wins, ADR, KAST%, K/D.
Message shown inside the Trend panel when only one match exists for the metric.
Muted text under the chart with match count, min/max, axis meaning and click hint.
Clickable dot on the trend chart that opens that match's page.
Monospace Steam ID shown beside the player name in the header.
Header card showing share of teammate deaths answered inside the trade window.
Alert shown inside the Trend panel when the career trend request fails.
Buttons (ADR, KAST%, K/D, HS%) that switch which metric the sparkline plots.
Panel titled "Trend" holding the metric toggles and the career sparkline chart.
SVG line chart of the selected metric across the player's match history.
Panel listing the player's top weapons by kills, damage and headshots.
Header card showing share of matches won (Win%) with W/M breakdown.
W or L badge in a match history row (reuses green/red status styling).
Muted note under the economy table with CT/T buy-class chips and round duration.

"Compare rounds" heading in the view header.
Side-by-side grid with one column per selected round (min 240px each).
One vertical card per compared round, headed "Round N" with winner and class chips.
"No events." placeholder inside an empty round event sequence.
Panel telling testers to open the match's Rounds tab and pick 2–4 rounds, shown when no selection was passed.
Per-round button that opens the Replay view seeked to that round's start tick.
Per-round button that opens the full round detail page.
Mini table per round showing CT/T equipment value, money and amount spent.

Ordered list of the first 30 events in the round rendered with the shared LandmarkRow (compact): ▶, tick, round chip, category chip and primary text — ▶/click open the Replay landmark feed at that tick.
"Round not found." placeholder inside a column whose detail failed to load.
List per round with kills, first blood, bomb site and MVP; the first-blood and MVP names link to their profiles with that round's side color.
Muted header text showing how many rounds were selected for comparison.
List of individual grenades per round with kind chip, thrower name (a profile link), damage and flash time.
One-line grenade summary per round: count, total damage and total flash seconds.
✕ button that clears a saved or errored clip status chip.
Header chip showing recording/encoding/saved/error state with details in its tooltip.

Dropdown choosing free camera or a specific player slot to follow.
Monospace "f{frame}/{frames} · {tick}" text beside the scrubber.
Warning note if the position stream's frame count disagrees with metadata.
Primary button in the missing-replay panel that returns to the library.
Monospace "tick N" text in the header showing the current demo tick.
Dropdown that seeks the replay to the start of a chosen round (warmups and bomb site noted).
"⌨ hints" text whose tooltip lists playback shortcuts (Space, , . , arrows, L, F, 1-9, S).
The canonical event feed: typed events + chat + generic rows merged chronologically (category chips select the sources; paged with Load more).

Range slider that seeks the replay to any frame of the match.

all/opening/entry/trade/untraded toggle buttons above the Engagements table on the Combat tab.

Table in the Engagements panel listing each duel with replay button, tick, round, kind, players, distance, and winner.
